text: One year program provides a sponsorship for 11 months and they cover the following aspects.Exempt from tuition fee.Provide accommodation on campus: economic double room (public restroom). If you choose to live off-campus and get approval from the university, off-campus living allowance is 700 RMB/month/person.Living allowance: 2500 RMB/month. Within the scholarship duration, registered scholarship students will receive a stipend from their host university each month. Students registering on or before the 15th of the month will receive a full stipend of that month. Those who register after the 15th of the month will receive a half stipend of that month. Graduating students will receive stipend until half month after the graduation date. If registered student stays out of China for more than 15 days in one month due to personal reasons (school holidays excluded), monthly stipend will be stopped during the leaving month(s).Provide comprehensive medical care insurance for International Students: 800 RMB/person/year.
